ranking_formula: score = EV_p10 = 10th percentile over posterior parameter draws of [p_win*(decimal-1) - p_loss]. Qualify: EV_mean >= min_ev AND EV_p10 > min_ev_lower AND odds fresh AND goalies known AND market tier >= gate tier. Uncertainty, calibration and data quality enter through EV_p10 and the tier; goalie sensitivity is reported per bet.
no_edge_reason: 4 price(s) look favourable to the model, but no market has reached the EDGE_SUPPORTED validation tier yet (current: h2h BEATS_BASELINE, spreads BEATS_BASELINE, totals EXPERIMENTAL).
